_about: Outlets behind the Big Board (draft/). Each board snapshot lives in tools/draft_boards/<league>/<id>/<date>.json. kind: board (ranks talent, feeds the consensus) or mock (projects picks, shown separately). weight scales a source in the consensus; recency lowers it further. status pending = not published for this class yet, so nothing to read. how: auto (a script pulls it), paste (tools/draft_paste.py from copied page text).

nba.name: No Ceilings
nba.note: Staff composite Top 60; posts as <year>-nba-draft-big-board-v<N>. Composite only, not the paid personal boards.

nba.name: NBADraft.net
nba.note: Top 100 big board. Their extended mock is tracked as its own source below.

nfl.note: Itself a consensus of 60+ boards and 200+ mocks, so it counts double. Free view stops at 100.
